body:
Adds `research/delayed-outer` (MIT): exact stability limit `α·s < 2 sin(π/(4τ+2))` for overlapped outer sync, a no-free-lunch result (step-size cap cancels throughput gained, so naive overlap is 1.0–1.25× slower than blocking), and curvature-based delay compensation that recovers the delay-free rate (2–17× less wallclock). Includes 11 unit tests, experiments, whitepaper, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
